topicB: Data Quality and Signal Loss in B2B Marketing

recap.intro: This week you explored two exciting areas of B2B marketing, diving into how technology is reshaping our strategies and how we handle the information that drives them.
bullets: Agentic AI is shifting content creation towards orchestration, highlighting the ongoing need for human oversight.
The real challenge with AI isn't getting products into AI systems, but ensuring those systems can complete purchases through human-designed checkouts.
AI's performance is directly tied to the quality of the data it's fed, meaning messy data leads to bigger mistakes.
As customer tracking data becomes harder to get, marketers must focus on making the most of the information they already possess.
recap.closing: This week you learned that while AI is rapidly changing B2B marketing, human oversight and high-quality data remain essential for success.
